title: Geological Information for Slope Hazard Risk Assessment - No.2: Geological information of Kyushu area

artifacts.rasterStructure: 4810x3352, RGB Byte, no CRS, no GeoTransform, no numeric thickness band

sourceStatement: The map is a terrain-surface minus interpreted Aso-4 ignimbrite top elevation difference, supported by published maps, KuniJiban cores and field survey.
exclusions: Do not treat RGB values as thickness in metres

Do not apply outside the eastern Aso-4 ignimbrite plateau
